metadata.title: Cross-ratios and first order ordinary differential equations
metadata.abstract: We investigate the usefulness of the cross-ratio in the study of first order odes of the form $y^\prime=P_ny^n+P_{n-1}y^{n-1}+\ldots+P_1y+P_0,\;\; (P_i)_{0\leqslant i\leqslant n}\in K,\;n\geqslant1$, where $K$ is a differential field of characteristic zero with algebraically closed field of constants. We discover along the way many differential algebraic identity between solutions to that equation. We also explain why the cross-ratio of any four solutions to such an equation is in general not constant when $n\geq3$ by exhibiting an obstruction which prevents its constancy when $n\geq3$. Finally to any separable polynomial $P_\varphi(z)=z^{n+1}+\varphi_1z^n+\varphi_2z^{n-1}+\ldots+\varphi_{n+1}$, $n\geq2$, over a differential field of meromorphic function on some domain of $\mathbb C$ with the usual derivation we associate a uniquely defined first order ode of the form $y^\prime=P_ny^n+P_{n-1}y^{n-1}+\ldots+P_1y+P_0,\;\; (P_i)_{0\leqslant i\leqslant n}\in K$ such that every root of $P_\varphi(z)$ is a solution to the said differential equation.

analysis.workSummary: 研究微分域上多项式一阶 ODE 解的交比，给出 n≥3 时交比通常不恒定的障碍；对可分多项式构造以各根为解的唯一相应一阶方程。
analysis.breakthrough: 把 Riccati 型交比现象的失效与高次方程结构相联系。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方摘要和作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读完整证明。特征零及代数闭常数域等假设必须保留；不能把通常不恒定写成任何高次方程均无恒定交比。 AI 披露另见独立全文核查。
